description: Minimal capability set for the main window. Phase 1/2 exposed no filesystem, shell, or process permissions. Phase 3 adds the app's own `process_spawn` / `process_write` / `process_kill` / `process_status` commands; these are custom app commands (not plugin permissions), so no extra capability is granted here. `core:default` allows the window to `listen` for `process://stdout|stderr|exit`. `http:default` enables the AI provider transport (requests run in Rust, so remote OpenAI-compatible endpoints without CORS headers are reachable); its scope allows any HTTPS origin plus local HTTP endpoints (Ollama / LM Studio / LocalAI). No tauri-plugin-shell / tauri-plugin-process is installed, and no filesystem or generic-shell permission is granted.
